description: ISO metric M-profile screw thread limits (ASME B1.13M-2005 / ISO 965), internal class 6H and external classes 6g, 6h and 4g6g, M1.6 to M100, coarse and fine pitches. Dimensions in millimetres. Transcribed from Machinery's Handbook 31st ed., Table 12 'Internal Metric Thread - M Profile Limiting Dimensions' and Table 13 'External Metric Thread - M Profile Limiting Dimensions' (book pages 2027-2032, PDF pages 2038-2043). 'coarse' marks the standard coarse pitch for that diameter. Used by the thread stripping check; see docs/thread-stripping-reference.md.
